subject: Ultimate box savegame
author: Xandu
body:
I can't confirm this but I would be very surprised if you can still load your old savegame in "Burnout Paradise Ultimate Box" since it is a new game. By new I mean that it is not just an update but actually a new SKU (stock keeping unit).

This is exactly the same thing that happened when the game was released in the PS store. People that bought this also had to redo the game.

 

-- The Creator --

subject: No, it's not true, for me
author: gravy666
body: No, it's not true, for me at least.
